failure_analysis.why: Neo4j sub_scores dramatically worse (neo4j_createEdge: 2876→10136, neo4j_shortestPath: 724→5644). Likely causes: (1) environment noise from concurrent Docker containers in earlier executors, (2) label cache ConcurrentHashMap overhead, (3) benchmark ran after other executors exhausted Docker resources
failure_analysis.lesson: Label cache approach minimal effect on AGE createEdge (8342→8220, <2%). Neo4j results highly variable under Docker resource pressure — need isolated benchmark runs. age_createEdge bottleneck requires deeper investigation (possibly AGE tx BEGIN/COMMIT cost, not MATCH cost)
